originalSql: WITH RECURSIVE dates(day) AS (SELECT MIN(txn_date) FROM customer_transactions UNION ALL SELECT date(day,'+1 day') FROM dates WHERE day < (SELECT MAX(txn_date) FROM customer_transactions)), txn AS (SELECT customer_id, txn_date, SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type='deposit' THEN txn_amount ELSE -txn_amount END) AS net FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id, txn_date), cust AS (SELECT customer_id, MIN(txn_date) AS first_d, MAX(txn_date) AS last_d FROM customer_transactions GROUP BY customer_id), spine AS (SELECT c.customer_id, d.day, c.first_d FROM cust c JOIN dates d ON d.day BETWEEN c.first_d AND c.last_d), bal AS (SELECT s.customer_id, s.day, s.first_d, SUM(COALESCE(t.net,0)) OVER (PARTITION BY s.customer_id ORDER BY s.day) AS balance FROM spine s LEFT JOIN txn t ON t.customer_id=s.customer_id AND t.txn_date=s.day), roll AS (SELECT customer_id, day, first_d, AVG(balance) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS ravg, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY day ROWS BETWEEN 29 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cnt FROM bal), daily AS (SELECT customer_id, strftime('%Y-%m',day) AS month, first_d, CASE WHEN ravg<0 THEN 0 ELSE ravg END AS floored FROM roll WHERE cnt=30), per_cm AS (SELECT customer_id, month, MAX(floored) AS mx FROM daily WHERE month <> strftime('%Y-%m', first_d) GROUP BY customer_id, month) SELECT month AS month, ROUND(SUM(mx),2) AS total_max_30day_avg_balance FROM per_cm GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
